decisions.reason: The multi-model height-adjustable desk line carries substantial development investment and is central to the announced flexible-workplace direction, and post-pandemic office reorganization gives management a ready explanation for any weak results, so persistence is likely.
A chair family close to the core offer costs little to keep in a configurable premium range and remains a justified part of the established business.

The floor cushion line is tied to the rug collection the firm presents as its flagship, so management will likely attribute modest sales to market build-up and keep it, though it is a peripheral accessory that could be pruned.
The sofa was only mentioned rather than showcased, so commitment is weaker and a model refresh could replace it, but it fits the core upholstery offer and is probably still kept.
The high standing table supports the workplace and conference direction and has its own page, and its pandemic-hit commercial sales can be blamed on temporary causes.

The rug collection is the publicly presented flagship of the firm's new direction, and that heavy visible commitment and need to justify the strategic move make continuation very likely despite its distance from the core.
